name: Falch beam rob 250 e
summary: Fully automatic electric water-jetting robot from Falch that moves the jet along a beam axis at up to 3,000 bar; Falch lists it among its robots for concrete renovation.

germany.statusNote: German maker near Ulm; the product page shows 'ask for price' and a product hotline. Falch says it has rental, sales and service points across Europe; the beam rob is for rent only as a trailer version.

sellers.name: Falch GmbH
sellers.note: Street of water jetting 1, 89143 Blaubeuren-Seissen. Price on request ('ask for price'); product hotline +49 7344 9244-4148. Rental only as trailer version.

notes: Beam-type robot: the jetting unit travels along one electric x-axis; z-axis optional. It does not drive itself between work areas (no drive listed).
Protection rating given as 'IP65 / IP54' (likely different components); ipRating uses the first value.
Needs a separate 3,000 bar high-pressure pump unit.
